concerns.text: The plan mentions generating a per‑crystal‑system metric CSV file (`metrics_by_system.csv`) in Phase 9, but this artifact is not defined in the `data-model.md`. The data model lists only `interpretability_report.md` as a reporting artifact. Add a definition for `metrics_by_system.csv` (its schema, columns, and provenance) to `data-model.md` to keep the design documents consistent.
